The group must contend with a new set of issues while out on a mission, and must push through to survive.
Cautiously, members of our group must venture into a familiar location on a heroic rescue mission. It's a huge stage, but so are the stakes.
The group is spread thin with some members holding down the church and the others being on a rescue mission.
New enemies disregard rules and morals, although Rick wants to find a peaceful agreement, the enemies seem to prefer a more violent resolution.

st: What Happened and What's Going On
d: After facing all the recent trials, a slight detour may offer the solution that the group has been seeking.
